figures.Fig24.4: Distribution of lions found in Africa and North and South America. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch24-fig-biogeography (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book's example compares the African lion with 'the mountain lion of America'; the mountain lion (puma) is a different genus, so the lesson adds a note that the shared features reflect the cat family's common ancestry, flagged. The printed map is replaced by a diagram of the three biogeographic patterns.
